summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency resolves and executes arbitrary code at install
details: package.json declares `dependencies.libsignal` as `github:pernapasquale647-dotcom/paki-libsignal` — an off-registry GitHub source with no tag, branch pin, or commit SHA. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever the repository's default HEAD points to at that moment and runs any lifecycle scripts inside it. The referenced repository is under the same author's control as this package, and its contents (and lifecycle hooks) can change at any time without any change to this package version, so the installed bytes bypass registry review and integrity checks. This is the off-registry unpinned dependency shape (CWE-829): the manifest line is itself the install-time execution vector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
